label: Spontaneous Pneumomediastinum in COVID-19 and Myasthenic-like Symptom Complications in Two Relatives: A Coincidence or Spike Toxicity with Thymic Response in Predisposed Individuals? Two Clinical Cas…
summary: Pneumomediastinum (PM) in SARS-CoV-2 infections can have a multifaceted presentation. The most frequently described cases of spontaneous PM (SPM) occurred during the first waves of the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic due to alveolar fragility related to severe cases of interstitial pneumonia and vascular injury that predisposed to alveolar destruction and to the Macklin effect in PM development.
